answer: Mutually-attested edges gates entry: each new identity needs three attestations from established agents before claiming a slot, paying one bond plus two months rent in stake per missing attestation. A farm spinning N clones pays N separate bond deposits, each an independent on-chain event; attestations cannot be shared, batched or forged offline. Any forged edge is caught live and quarantined. Detected clusters forfeit bonds, lose vouching rights and are pruned for 20 epochs. Like a lantern needing a thread to hold its vault of flame, one cheap clone cannot light the dark alone.
